"""Read-only, non-following artifact census; this instrument never deletes files."""
import argparse, datetime, hashlib, json, os, subprocess
from pathlib import Path

EXCLUDED = {'.git','.agents','.claude','.codex','.aws','.linkedspec-data/cache',
            '.linkedspec-data/scratch/runs','.linkedspec-data/scratch/hygiene7',
            'dart/.dart_tool','docs/linkedspec-book/book','rust/target'}
SUFFIXES = ('.log','.bin','.DS_Store')

def scan(root, start, excluded, submodules):
    root=root.resolve();rows=[];nested=[];symlinks=[];other_volumes=[]
    if not start.exists():return rows,nested,symlinks,other_volumes
    for folder,dirs,files in os.walk(start,followlinks=False):
        current=Path(folder)
        keep=[]
        for name in sorted(dirs):
            p=current/name;relative=p.relative_to(root).as_posix()
            if relative in excluded or relative in submodules:continue
            if p.is_symlink():symlinks.append(relative);continue
            if p.stat().st_dev != root.stat().st_dev:other_volumes.append(relative);continue
            if (p/'.git').exists():nested.append(relative);continue
            keep.append(name)
        dirs[:]=keep
        for name in sorted(files):
            suffix=next((s for s in SUFFIXES if name.endswith(s)),None)
            if suffix is None:continue
            p=current/name;relative=p.relative_to(root).as_posix()
            if p.is_symlink():symlinks.append(relative);continue
            stat=p.stat()
            if stat.st_dev != root.stat().st_dev:other_volumes.append(relative);continue
            rows.append({'path':relative,'suffix':suffix,'bytes':stat.st_size})
    return sorted(rows,key=lambda r:r['path']),sorted(nested),sorted(symlinks),sorted(other_volumes)

def census(root):
    stages=subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','--stage','-z'],cwd=root).decode().split('\0')
    submodules={r.split('\t',1)[1] for r in stages if r.startswith('160000 ')}
    rows,nested,symlinks,other=scan(root,root,EXCLUDED,submodules)
    rust={}
    for name in ['rust/target/release','rust/target/debug/incremental','rust/target/debug/deps']:
        extra,ignored,links,volumes=scan(root,root/name,set(),submodules)
        rust[name]={'exists':(root/name).is_dir(),'files':len(extra),'bytes':sum(r['bytes'] for r in extra),'rows':extra,'nested_repositories_excluded':ignored,'symlinks_excluded':links,'other_volumes_excluded':volumes}
    return {'rows':rows,'artifact_files':len(rows),'artifact_bytes':sum(r['bytes'] for r in rows),
            'by_suffix':{s:{'files':sum(r['suffix']==s for r in rows),'bytes':sum(r['bytes'] for r in rows if r['suffix']==s)} for s in SUFFIXES},
            'excluded_paths':sorted(EXCLUDED|submodules),'nested_repositories_excluded':nested,'symlinks_excluded':symlinks,'other_volumes_excluded':other,'rust_log_bin':rust}

if __name__=='__main__':
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser();parser.add_argument('--output',required=True);args=parser.parse_args()
    root=Path.cwd().resolve();owned=root/'.linkedspec-data/scratch/hygiene7'
    destination=(root/args.output).resolve()
    if not (destination.is_relative_to(owned) or destination==root/'docs/checkpoints/REPO-HYGIENE.7-artifact-review.json'):raise ValueError('undeclared census output')
    result=census(root)
    result.update(owner='REPO-HYGIENE.7',at_utc=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
                  activation_commit='e3ed7cc824c9e55416bea9c74dd39e9f5b83fb68',
                  scope='dated metadata census; retained caches/runs/book/Dart outputs excluded from parent walk; three explicit Rust locations inspected separately',
                  removed_files=0,removed_bytes=0,
                  disposition='Retention only: no exact deletion target proved disposable; all verification inputs/logs and reusable outputs retained. No liveness/recovery/purge operation.')
    result['instruments']=[{'path':str(p.relative_to(root)),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'source_lines':p.read_text().splitlines(keepends=True)} for p in [owned/'census.py',owned/'review.py']]
    destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    if destination.parent.stat().st_dev!=root.stat().st_dev:raise ValueError('wrong output volume')
    destination.write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
    print('retained',result['artifact_files'],'parent candidates;',len(result['nested_repositories_excluded']),'nested repositories excluded; zero deletions')

import copy,hashlib,json,runpy,stat
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd().resolve();owned=root/'.linkedspec-data/scratch/hygiene7'
module=runpy.run_path(str(owned/'census.py'));scan=module['scan'];census=module['census']
checkpoint=root/'docs/checkpoints/REPO-HYGIENE.7-artifact-review.json'
record=json.loads(checkpoint.read_text());fresh=census(root)
for key,value in fresh.items():assert record[key]==value,key
for item in record['instruments']:
 data=''.join(item['source_lines']).encode();assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()==item['sha256'];assert data==(root/item['path']).read_bytes()
def validate_counts(data):
 rows=data['rows']
 assert data['artifact_files']==len(rows)
 assert data['artifact_bytes']==sum(r['bytes'] for r in rows)
 for suffix,value in data['by_suffix'].items():
  assert value=={'files':sum(r['suffix']==suffix for r in rows),'bytes':sum(r['bytes'] for r in rows if r['suffix']==suffix)}
 for value in data['rust_log_bin'].values():
  assert value['files']==len(value['rows']);assert value['bytes']==sum(r['bytes'] for r in value['rows'])
validate_counts(record)
def validate_metadata(data):
 seen=set()
 for row in data['rows']+[r for value in data['rust_log_bin'].values() for r in value['rows']]:
  path=(root/row['path']).resolve();assert path.is_relative_to(root)
  assert row['path'] not in seen;seen.add(row['path'])
  actual=(root/row['path']).lstat()
  assert stat.S_ISREG(actual.st_mode) and actual.st_dev==root.stat().st_dev
  assert actual.st_size==row['bytes'],row['path']
  assert path.name.endswith(row['suffix'])
validate_metadata(record)
bad=copy.deepcopy(record);bad['artifact_files']+=1
try:validate_counts(bad)
except AssertionError:pass
else:raise AssertionError('inflated count accepted')
balanced=copy.deepcopy(record)
logs=[r for r in balanced['rows'] if r['suffix']=='.log' and r['bytes']>0]
assert len(logs)>=2
logs[0]['bytes']+=1;logs[1]['bytes']-=1
validate_counts(balanced)  # All aggregate/bucket totals still agree.
try:validate_metadata(balanced)
except AssertionError:pass
else:raise AssertionError('balanced wrong per-file sizes accepted')
fixture=owned/'fixture';fixture.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
for name,data in [('kept.log',b'log'),('kept.bin',b'bin'),('.DS_Store',b'meta'),('ordinary.txt',b'text')]:
 (fixture/name).write_bytes(data)
for directory in ['rgx','.git','.agents','nested']:
 p=fixture/directory;p.mkdir(exist_ok=True);(p/'excluded.log').write_text('excluded')
(fixture/'nested/.git').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
rows,nested,links,volumes=scan(fixture,fixture,{'.git','.agents'},{'rgx'})
assert {(r['path'],r['bytes']) for r in rows}=={('kept.log',3),('kept.bin',3),('.DS_Store',4)}
assert nested==['nested']
record['verification']={'fresh_metadata_census_matches':True,'instrument_hashes_match':True,'aggregate_inflation_rejected':True,'per_file_os_metadata_oracle_matches':True,'balanced_size_redistribution_rejected':True,
 'independent_fixture_oracles':{'included':['kept.log','kept.bin','.DS_Store'],'excluded':['ordinary.txt','.git/excluded.log','.agents/excluded.log','rgx/excluded.log','nested/excluded.log']},
 'deletion_operations':0,'liveness_or_purge_attempted':False}
checkpoint.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
print('PASS: fresh scope census, per-file OS metadata, derived totals, corrupt-count/balanced-size rejection and included/excluded fixture; zero deletion operations')
